title: Emergency Sell All neither pauses nor stops buying, and the dashboard has no Pause button, so the bot keeps sniping during and after an emergency sell-all and any position bought meanwhile is left open

evidence.note: emergency-sell never calls setPauseState and never stops a chain
the dashboard only GETs /api/controls/pause (useWebSocket.ts:72) and POSTs /resume (PauseBanner.tsx:58); no dashboard control POSTs /pause
the dialog promises to "market sell ALL open positions across ALL chains"; nothing says buying continues

sibling_sites_checked: Every dashboard control that could halt entries: chain Stop (does not stop buying, AUD-BUY-011), pause (no dashboard button; CLI scripts/pause.ts and the API route only), CB reset (anti-rug only). The pause flag is honoured by the buy handlers (AUD-BUY-011 evidence bot.ts:1034-1040, :1351-1357). Emergency-sell selects its rows once at the start (controls.ts:126), so a buy that lands during the loop is never in it.
severity_rationale: S2 EXPOSURE: an emergency sell-all is pressed exactly when the operator wants out of the market, but new snipes keep being bought and stay open (and a long loop, AUD-API-004, widens the window). Bounded by the per-trade size and position limits; the operator can pause from the command line.
recommendation: Decide (card API-02) whether Emergency Sell All sets the global pause first (and says so), and add a Pause control to the dashboard. Phase 24 with the emergency-sell rework.
